environment.description: Same application deployed on EKS 1.28 with Pod Security Admission (PSA) enforcing 'restricted' profile at namespace level. Container securityContext specifies: runAsNonRoot=true, readOnlyRootFilesystem=true, allowPrivilegeEscalation=false, capabilities drop=[ALL] (which includes CAP_NET_RAW, CAP_SYS_ADMIN, CAP_SYS_PTRACE among others). Resource limits: memory=256Mi with OOMKill policy. The pod has a sidecar envoy proxy with ext_authz filter requiring mTLS client certificates for any /debug/* path. Kubernetes NetworkPolicy restricts ingress to only the envoy sidecar on port 8080, blocking direct pod access. JMX port 9090 is not exposed in the container port spec and NetworkPolicy blocks all traffic to it.

config.network_policy: ingress only from envoy sidecar on 8080; egress restricted to vault and DB endpoints only

envoy_sidecar.ext_authz: mTLS client cert required for /debug/* routes
